Study Sprint: a second, professional UI

The brief: more professional and plain, no big colour gradients or AI-looking effects, usable by a medical student, light and dark, and maybe accents. Below are the current design and two options, both built as real CSS layers on the running app (html[data-ui="clinical"] and html[data-ui="paper"]) and screenshotted with seeded medical decks. Every text colour passes WCAG AA in both modes and all five accents, and no screen scrolls sideways at 375 or 1440 px wide.

Implementation notes

Switching

  • Ship the layer as css/ui2.css, linked after styles.css (or appended to it). Everything is scoped under html[data-ui], so Classic is untouched.
  • Store the choice with the theme: { skin, mode, oled, ui } where ui is 'classic' | 'clinical' (or paper). cleanTheme() and applyTheme() in js/themes.js set or remove data-ui like they do data-skin.
  • The head script in index.html reads t.ui from the same localStorage key and sets data-ui before first paint (2 lines, keep in step with cleanTheme), so there is no flash of the wrong style.
  • Paper only: add Source+Serif+4 to the Google Fonts link. Clinical needs no font at all (system stack).

Settings row

  • Appearance gets a Style segmented control (Classic | Clinical) above Theme, as in the Settings screenshots (markup mocked in for the preview).
  • Under the new style, "Theme" is labelled Accent colour and the cards become plain swatches (pure CSS; the descriptions are hidden).
  • Accent names come from a second name table in SKINS picked by the style: Indigo, Blue, Green, Rust, Plum.
  • Light / Dark / Match my device and OLED stay as they are.

Pure CSS vs markup tweaks

  • Pure CSS: Today, Review, Decks, deck page, card list, Stats, sidebar, sheets, Play, Import (the sparkle on the Claude button is removed).
  • Small JS / markup: the Style row, the accent names, data-ui in the head script and applyTheme, and the browser-bar colour (already read from --bg).
  • To review when building: first-run and landing (.lp-*, phone mock-up gradient), Play results stamp, occlusion editor, the motion effects in fx.js (glows are neutralised through --glow, but the rating pulse may want a quieter version).
  • Logo: kept. If the lightning bolt feels too "sprint", a plain card mark is a 1-line SVG swap.

How accents map

The five existing skins are remapped, so saved themes and sync keep working. Light uses a deep tone for fills and text; dark uses a mid tone for fills (white text) and a light tone for links.
